description: Make a Claude Code account the global one (it must be signed in), like /login: its sign-in moves into ~/.claude and the old global account's goes to that account's folder. Every Claude Code on ~/.claude that isn't pinned, started by the worker or by hand, uses the new account with its next message, without a restart (`following`; within `switch_delay_s` seconds on macOS). Windows pinned to the new account are restarted on ~/.claude and windows pinned to the old one on its folder, resuming their conversations (`restarted`; working ones after their turn: `after_turn`). While a window pinned to the new account is in a turn, the switch waits (`state: waiting`, `waiting_for`, the snapshot's `pending_global`) and the worker finishes it once they are idle; another switch replaces it, switching to the current global account cancels it. Errors are one JSON object `{code, message, blocked_by?}` with `code` `not_signed_in`, `busy` (Claude Code is renewing its sign-in), `blocked` (a Claude Code on that account's folder can't be restarted: `blocked_by`), `owner_check_on` or `failed` (anything else).

after_turn.description: Panes pinned to the old account that restart on its folder once their turn ends.

following.description: Claude Code panes on ~/.claude that aren't pinned: they use the new account with their next message.

global.description: The global account now (the old one while the switch waits).

restarted.description: Pinned panes restarted now (the new account's on ~/.claude, the old one's on its folder).

waiting_for.description: Panes on the new account's folder the switch waits for.
